stops.name: Parco regionale delle Valli del Cedra e del Parma
stops.detail: The regional park of Valli del Cedra and Parma, also known as the Cento Laghi park, is a protected natural area located in the upper Parmense Apennine. Including in the municipalities of Corniglio, Monchio delle Corti, Tizzano Val Parma and Neviano degli Arduini protects the high valley of Cedra, the high Val Bratica and some areas of the upper Val Parma.
